verdict.rationale: Lighthouse is an immigration-services provider with case-preparation software. A platform like this could plausibly offer bulk actions, such as an employer acting on many candidate cases at once, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only per-case document upload and tracking, plus adjacent employer features (consolidated billing, candidate progress reports, workforce pathway planning). No documented bulk-operation capability appears, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
